en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal ceremony around a large war memorial statue of a standing soldier in uniform on a high pedestal. The scene is outdoors in a landscaped park with tall trees and trimmed hedges. Crowds and uniformed or costumed men are gathered around the monument, suggesting an unveiling or commemoration event. The stone pedestal has faint inscription panels; at the very bottom edge of the card, some handwritten or printed text appears in reverse, likely the caption or location.
